findings.fix: Build the underlying map of `quotientDerivation D` as `Submodule.mapQLinear (I.restrictScalars R) (I.restrictScalars R) ⟨(D : Module.End R A), D.property⟩`; then `map_add' D E := Subtype.ext (map_add (Submodule.mapQLinear _ _) _ _)`, `map_smul' r D := Subtype.ext (map_smul (Submodule.mapQLinear _ _) r _)`, and `map_lie'` from `map_sub (Submodule.mapQLinear _ _)` followed by `Submodule.mapQ_comp` twice (bracket is `D * E - E * D` in `Module.End`). Optionally take `toSubmodule` from `(Submodule.compatibleMaps (I.restrictScalars R) (I.restrictScalars R)).comap (derivationLieAlgebra R A).toSubmodule.subtype` so only `lie_mem'` is proved by hand; membership stays `Iff.rfl`.
findings.issue: `smul_mem'` of `stableDerivations` unfolds `Algebra.smul_def` and uses `mul_mem_left` to show `r • y ∈ I` for `y ∈ I`; that is `Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem` (available since `Algebra R A` gives `IsScalarTower R A A`). More broadly the zero/add/smul closure of `{D | ∀ x ∈ I, D x ∈ I}` is `Submodule.compatibleMaps`.

summary: No existing declaration replaces the new stabilizer subalgebra or the descent homomorphism, so the material is new. But the Lie-hom structure proofs and the ideal-stability closure hand-rederive `Submodule.mapQLinear`, `Submodule.mapQ_comp`, `Submodule.mapQ_mkQ`, and `Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem`, exactly the API Mathlib's own `LieSubmodule.Quotient.actionAsEndoMap` uses for the same descent.
